title: Fair Generalized Linear Models with a Convex Penalty
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not analyze aspects of religion or faith. Its focus is on algorithmic fairness in Generalized Linear Models (GLMs) with respect to sensitive attributes like race and gender.
findings: This paper does not contain any analysis or findings related to religion. The work is focused on developing a fair statistical modeling framework (F-GLM) and evaluating its performance on benchmark datasets where fairness is considered in terms of race and gender.
